page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal style instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge offers a dense allocation of dedicated physical cores and memory resources, making it suitable for enterprise-scale workloads that demand high memory capacity without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
